items.title: Millionaires Furniture
items.creator: HorizonBlocks
items.description:
Decorate your modern home with more than 1800 furniture variants. Design your living room, gaming room, bathroom, kitchen, garden, dining room, bedroom to your imagination. Drive around the city in different millionaire cars and choose your dream mansion.

+ FURNITURE STORE
+ SUPERCARS
+ 7 MILLIONAIRE MANSIONS
+ 6 SKINS INCLUDED! (two free)

items.title: Dark Masked Suits
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Love the dark? Then these dark masked skins with stylish suits are just for you! Get your very fashionable mask skin and show off in your modern city!

- 10 trendy masked skins!
- 1 free skin!
- Perfect for roleplay and PVP!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Knight Castle
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
You always wanted to be the master of a magnificent castle? Then now is your time! Grab the crown and create your own kingdom.

- Beautiful medieval castle
- Wide surrounding area with lumberjack hut and ruin
- Furnished in detail
- By Team Ethyria

items.title: Millionaire's Cliff Mansion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Grab this exclusive estate up for sale! Enjoy unparalleled views and privacy atop steep rocks! Secure amazing perks such as a helicopter landing pad and a giant pool!

- Mansion survival spawn
- By Geniely

items.title: Cool Drivers
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Hit the road, windows down, music playing, hair blowing in the wind, down the scenic route into the sunset! Driving has just become even cooler! Ride in style with the skins of Cool Drivers!

- 12 Driver skins
- By Rareloot

items.title: Goth Fashion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Dark, edgy and cool new looks are yours to have! Dive into the monochrome world of goths! A fantastical fantasy fashion adventure is waiting!

- 12 Goth skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Rose Fashion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Fancy and cute new looks are here! Flower power is back and cuter than ever! Get yourself some beautiful rosy floral styles!

- 12 Cute skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Lucky Block Rainbow Race
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
A Lucky Block Rainbow Race situated high in the sky! 300+ different outcomes with many dangerous and exciting mobs/builds.
Determine among your friends who is a noob and who is a pro!

- Race with your friends!
- 300+ different outcomes!

items.title: Millionaire Icons

items.description:
It's time to become mega rich! Dress up as a millionaire teen and look your coolest.

+ 12 teen skins
+ Unique millionaire outfits

items.description:
Do you want to be one of the trendy demons?

+8 HQ demon teen skins!
+By FALL Studios

items.description:
Test your luck with the Rainbow Lucky Blocks! Destroy the Blocks and get ready for 300 different outcomes!

+Skyblock experience!

+By FALL Studios

items.title: Into the Sky
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Jump in your plane and take to the skies! The whole world is waiting to be discovered by you, don't waste time and start your next action-packed survival adventure!

+Custom plane
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Hype Teens
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
Set the latest fashion and style trends as a hype teen! Role-play with your friends, build your own modern worlds, and go shopping as one of ten stylish skins! One skin included for free.
From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Luxury Couple Teens
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Ready for a luxurious life? These couples are wearing the newest and coolest outfits, grab one of them and show everyone your new style!

+2 free skins!
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Rich Fashion
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
You probably dream of wealth, ostentation and luxury, right? Experience it all and more with your friends with these 12 perfect skins to be a successful millionaire!

+Perfect for playing with friends
+2 free skins

items.title: PrestonPlayz Would You Rather
items.creator: Meatball Inc
items.description:
Over 60 NEW minigames! Challenge your friends to 30 extreme would you rather questions! Would you rather fight mutants on a dinosaur or dragon? Break into a secure house or bank vault? Dodge meteors or a volcano eruption? What will YOU decide!

- 30 epic questions
- 60 extreme minigame options
- Custom weapons and vehicles
- Single or multiplayer

By CinemaCraft & Preston

items.title: Craftable Secure Houses
items.creator: Meatball Inc
items.description:
Upgrade your base security! Join PrestonPlayz to craft and fortify 10 secure bases with over 19 traps and gadgets! Challenge your friends to break into your nuclear bunker, fortified nether castle, bedrock base and more! 

- 19 security gadgets and traps
- 4 secure vehicles
- Turrets, landmines and more
- Custom terrain

By CinemaCraft and Preston

items.title: Zombie Simulator
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Be a Zombie! Graaaagh! But be careful! You burn at daytime. Can you play the game as a Zombie?

+ Multiplayer
+ Big Castle
+ Zombie Simulator
+ 4 Skins

items.title: Creators Blessing
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Become a great miner, hunter, explore or even navigate the oceans like an expert. 
Find the creator statues and offer them a gift in return for blessings that contain effects to give you the edge over everyone.

items.title: Neon Flux
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description: These neon cyber robots are the brightest and coolest skins of the year!

items.title: Steampunk - Original Textures
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Welcome to the fantasy universe of steampunk. Bring science fiction realism to your world with immersive retrofuturistic technology aesthetics. Inspired by 19th-century industrial steam-powered machines, this texture pack transforms your game into a fantastic adventure.

=> Super HD quality
=> Perfect for builders and creators
=> Vanilla friendly
=> Semi-realistic textures

items.title: Dragon Riders

- 11 skins

Everyone loves glitches and creepy shadows! This skin pack has plenty of glitches and neon shadow skins to choose from.

items.description:
Will you face this challenge? Try to reach the end of the maze. With lots of dungeons and loot to obtain, face the most terrible monsters that await you!

+ Dungeons
